review_method: Agent-reviewed against the bundled EU_AI_Act.html and its converted Markdown before running retrieval. Provision labels are manually annotated; no generated assessment or inferred chunk metadata is used as ground truth. q25+ were picked by reading the provision each question needs in corpus/*.md (AI Act and both Commission guidelines) before running retrieval.
scope: Passage retrieval, not legal conclusions or semantic support. A negated scenario still needs the relevant rule or exception. q01-q24 target the regulation; q25+ also target the Commission guidelines; q59+ the Article 50, GPAI and draft high-risk guidelines. Style is derived: queries citing an Article/Annex/Recital are 'legal', the rest 'lay'.

expected.quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
